purpose: Implement concrete unregistered two-phase PM Return workflow with atomic Web SQL audit and original committed journal receipt.
publication_policy: Parent sole publisher; isolated worker; independent review and exact-head/base CI.
sql_policy: No real SQL connections/execution, schema apply, database creation/drop, credentials, services, TLS, permission or security changes. Recording production-workflow tests only; actual SQL runtime separately authorized.
constraints: Preserve B01/P01/I06/I07/I09 immutable claims and API/DI/readiness/FE/shared contracts
I09 store change only transaction-owned internal probe/lookup seam; preserve standalone semantics
Two-phase custody: confirmed reservation commit ACK held only by current invocation, then SERIALIZABLE execution transaction; no restart/TTL takeover or key reuse
ERP effect, source-defined legacy log, Web SQL audit and original committed receipt must share one execution transaction and commit
New unapplied Web audit artifact with strict binding/version/shape/index/check probes and exact-byte hash; attributes only pin this new schema path to LF
Postprocedure validate transaction ownership, @@TRANCOUNT=1, XACT_STATE=1 and source-backed poststate/log; never replace lost nested transaction with autocommit audit
Typed audit INSERT/readback and journal2-to1 CAS exactly one row matching binding/slot/attempt/correlation; read back both before commit
Replay verifies persisted audit against original journal receipt after fresh session/authority; preserve original fingerprint despite authority refresh
SQL-equal candidates reach full-byte validation; no pre-codec length filter; bounded indexes and consistent lock order
No Committed response until commit ACK; ambiguous outcomes preserve key/reservation and deny retry dispatch
No raw reason/password/stamp/token/private SQL/data/path/fixture output in public artifacts
Harness executes production orchestrator and adversarial command/transaction recording; does not prove real SQL locking/durability
StateEqualityToken is not ABA protection and no client expected version exists; stale-state business semantics remain unresolved, no activation
